tables.title: 800V DC transition
rows: 800V DC: quoting NOW, first orders H2 2026, shipments late 2027-early 2028; AC ~93% -> DC ~98% efficiency (~5% savings); ~10 SST pilots incl. hyperscalers
NVIDIA Vera Rubin grid-to-chip 800V DC partnership (Vertiv One Core, Eaton DSX)
Vertiv MV AC → LV AC → 800 VDC rack/pod architecture (MV BESS/UPS + DC busway + 800 VDC sidecar/pod + DC-DC shelf); IREN Sweetwater One (200 MW) designed for NVIDIA Rubin-era densities

120kW rack ~$9,500 (70% mid/low-V, 30% high-V) -> 800V/HVDC rack ~$115,000 at ~50/50 split (high-voltage ~10x, mid/low ~5-6x); ramp starts END-2027/EARLY-2028 (+/- a qtr), gradual with build-outs; AI-DC TAM raised ~$12B -> ~$48-50B by 2030 on installed gigawatts

AC-DC PSU 5-10kW -> 18-30kW ('power x2 = SiC content x5'); FOUR 800V inflections: (1) Si->SiC in AC/DC PSUs NOW (density-driven, independent of 800V); (2) 800V busbar via power SIDECAR mid-2027 (±400V variants H1-27) — SiC+GaN into DC/DC PSUs + BBUs; (3) NATIVE 800V GaN in GPU/XPU trays late-27/early-28, in steps across vendors ('not a digital switch'); (4) SSTs 2028+

Design wins RAMPING NOW at PSU makers LITEON and MACOM for multiple hyperscalers, spanning established AND emerging HVDC architectures; 800V raises SiC content across the power ecosystem, with new sockets in battery backup units, super capacitors, eFuses and HVDC-DC (incl. the secondary side). Voltage ladder: 750V/1.2kV discretes for PSUs NOW -> 2.3kV/3.3kV modules for SSTs, gated on hyperscaler RELIABILITY sign-off. Gen 5 SiC MOSFET (best specific Rds-on in industry) already running in the 200mm Mohawk Valley fab, so capacity is available rather than constrained. AI DC rev >2x FY25->FY26, +~20% QoQ in FQ4
